cards.prompt: You ordered an expensive laptop online, but it arrived two weeks late with a cracked screen. Write a formal complaint email to Customer Support requesting an immediate replacement or full refund.
followUps: Did you state your order number and purchase date clearly?
Is your tone polite yet firm and professional?
vocabulary: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with...
Upon opening the package, I discovered...
Under the circumstances, I request...
I look forward to your prompt response.
Sincerely,

Despite being assured that...
This severely disrupted our stay because...
I trust you will rectify this situation by...
Best regards,

Sincerely,
